thought.text: System preparation completed successfully. Let me verify the resulting state before driving the web installer:

reasoning_content:
`install.sh` completed successfully (exit 0). The system preparation is complete.

Next, let's check the state:
1. Whether Apache is running with the qisutu site
2. Whether MariaDB is running
3. Whether the bootstrap user exists
4. The systemd units that were created

After that, I'll run the web installer via curl.

action.command: echo "=== instance.conf ==="; cat /opt/qisutu/var/install/instance.conf; echo "=== services ==="; pgrep -x apache2 | head -2; mariadb-admin ping 2>&1; echo "=== systemd files ==="; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu; echo "=== apache sites ==="; ls /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/; echo "=== bootstrap ==="; ls -la /opt/qisutu/var/install/; echo "=== test web ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl
